name: dfirtrack/dfirtrack
description: An open-source web application for tracking and managing digital forensics and incident response cases, particularly for major incidents involving many affected systems such as APT compromises. Built on Django with a system-centric rather than case-centric data model.
score_rationale: Niche but purpose-built DFIR tracking application with 534 stars, specifically designed for the complex system-tracking needs of large-scale APT incident response.
